The main takeaway from our work is that
the vaccination program alone is unlikely to lead to COVID-19 elimination in the entire US, but it is likely to lead to the elimination of the pandemic in the state of New Jersey and Florida.

, for a vaccine with a protective efficacy of 70% or less, the herd immunity threshold for COVID 19 is likely to exceed 90% in the US, making it impossible to achieve herd immunity through vaccination alone, without a public mask wearing program or an effective and sustained social distancing measure.
